caption: Sweet Potato Waffles 🍠🧇 One of those easy toddler breakfasts I keep coming back to 🤍 Naturally a little sweet from the sweet potato, soft on the inside, and so easy to freeze for busy mornings. Ingredients * 1 cup mashed sweet potato * 2 eggs * ½ cup whole milk * ¾ cup all-purpose flour * 2 tbsp avocado oil or melted butter * 1 tsp baking powder * Pinch of cinnamon (optional) Directions Steam or boil the sweet potato until very soft and mash. Whisk the eggs, milk, and oil/butter, then mix in the sweet potato. Stir in the flour, baking powder, and cinnamon. Cook in a lightly greased waffle maker until golden and set 🧇 Using self-rising flour? Skip the baking powder. ❤️ This recipe is just one of 200+ inside MunchMind.
